title: Peach Pit-Activated Carbons: Effect of Row Material Form and Pyrolysis Parameters on Hydrogen Adsorption Storage
material_description: PPAC_WS_N2_1173 | activated carbon from whole peach-pit shells (Prunus persica pits, purchased locally), carbonized under N2 (673-1173 K) and CO2-activated at 1173 K for 60 min; EDX avg wt% C 65.30, O 28.73, K 5.03

notes: archive: Fig7_PPAC_WS_N2_1173.json; adsorption and desorption points share one marker style and cannot be told apart; coded adsorption (paper does not label individual points as desorption); x axis is labelled 'Relative Pressure (p/p°)' but is read as bar (caption and Table: 'up to 1 bar'); BET range: 0.01-0.30 of relative pressure P/P0; SSA printed 789.2 +/- 2.3 m2/g (N2, BET); Vult 0.181 and Vsup 0.127 cm3/g not coded (ultra-/super-micropore cutoffs not stated); degassed 473 K, 12 h, 1e-5 mbar before each H2 measurement
